title: $1,000 in gold in 2004 is now worth this
caption:
In 2004, gold was the first big gold ETF.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:GLD:2004-11-18} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with gold in 2004? 👇
